context.en: Emperor Dezong stands at left, opposite Xuanzong, in this later album of rulers. He is the emperor whose flight to Fengtian anchors the account of the 783 mutiny.
context.zh: 唐德宗在这册后世帝王图像的左页，右页为唐玄宗。他正是783年兵变后出奔奉天、贯穿本篇叙事的皇帝。

context.en: Xie Lingyun appears at left, opposite Tao Yuanming, in this undated portrait album. The poet and Yongjia governor is the central figure in this account of landscape poetry.
context.zh: 绘制年代未定的肖像册左页为谢灵运，右页为陶渊明。这位诗人与永嘉太守，正是条目所述山水诗故事的主角。

context.en: The Song imperial album portrays Gaozong at right, with his identification at left. It introduces the ruler whose court took refuge around Wenzhou in 1130.
context.zh: 宋代帝像册右页绘高宗，左页为身份题记。画像对应1130年朝廷在温州一带避难的故事主角。

context.en: Gaozong, shown at right in this undated imperial portrait album, made Lin’an the court’s official residence in 1138. The city functioned as the Southern Song capital.
context.zh: 年代未定的帝像册右页绘宋高宗。1138年，他将临安定为行在所；临安由此成为南宋实际上的都城。
